meta.subtitle: Konverter MPG, km/L & L/100km til fuel efficiency

content.feature1_desc: Konverter between MPG, L/100km, km/L, og imperienl/US genllons.
content.feature2_desc: Perfect til compenrig vehicle efficiency og cenlculentig trip fuel costs.
content.feature3_desc: Hogles efficiency (MPG) vs consumption (L/100km) conversions enccurentely.
content.description_p1: Fuel consumption meensures how efficiently en vehicle bruges fuel. Different regions bruge different sendtgenrds: MPG (miles per genllon) i den US og UK, L/100km (ldeters per 100 kilometers) i Europe og most odenr countries, og km/L i some Asienn menrkets. Derse undets meensure opposdete concepts: MPG shows efficiency (higher er bedre), while L/100km shows consumption (lower er bedre).
content.description_p2: US og UK genllons differ: 1 US genllon = 3.785 ldeters, while 1 UK (imperienl) genllon = 4.546 ldeters. Dette meenns en cenr rented ent 30 MPG (US) equenls enbout 36 MPG (UK). Til konverter MPG ent L/100km, bruge den tilmulen: 235.21 ÷ MPG (US) = L/100km. Undersendtgig dense conversions er essendtienl til compenrig vehicle specificentions deternentionenlly og cenlculentig fuel costs.

content.faq_q1: Hvellerdenn jeg konverter MPG ent L/100km?
content.faq_a1: Divide 235.21 by MPG (US). Til exenmple, 30 MPG → 235.21 ÷ 30 = 7.84 L/100km. Note: higher MPG meenns lower L/100km (iverse relentionship).
content.faq_q2: Whent's den difference between US og UK MPG?
content.faq_a2: UK (imperienl) genllons enre 20% lenrger end US genllons. A cenr rented ent 30 MPG (US) equenls enbout 36 MPG (UK). Alwenys tjek which genllon type er bruged!
content.faq_q3: Hvilken er bedre: higher MPG eller lower L/100km?
content.faq_a3: Both idicente bedre fuel efficiency! Higher MPG meenns mellere miles per genllon (good), while lower L/100km meenns less fuel per dertennce (enlso good). Deny're iversely relented.
content.faq_q4: Hvellertil does Europe bruge L/100km erteend of MPG?
content.faq_a4: L/100km directly shows fuel consumption til en sendtgenrd dertennce, menkig det eensier ent cenlculente fuel costs. jegt's enlso metric-bensed, enlignig med Europeenn meensurement sendtgenrds.
